Title: Azure Container Registry now available in several new regions

Body.Content:
Azure Container Registry is now generally available in the US Gov Texas, Germany West Central, and Brazil Southeast regions. See the list of all regions where Azure Container Registry is available and where it's coming next.

Azure Container Registry allows you to build, store, and manage images and artifacts for all types of container deployments. To learn more, read the Container Registry product page and documentation.
